description: This is a test source file using NUnit for API testing of employee workflow endpoints in OrangeHRM. It defines a test fixture class 'EmployeeWorkflowTests' with multiple test cases for creating, deleting, and querying job titles via HTTP API calls.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkflowTests
classes.description: A test fixture class containing tests for employee workflow API endpoints, including create, delete, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: Create_And_Delete_JobTitle_Workflow_Should_Succeed
methods.description: Tests creating a new job title and then deleting it, verifying success responses and data integrity.

methods.name: Pagination_Should_Return_At_Most_Limit_Items
methods.description: Tests retrieving a paginated list of job titles with a limit parameter and asserts the response contains at most the limited number of items.

methods.name: Delete_With_Empty_Ids_Should_Be_Rejected
methods.description: Tests that attempting to delete job titles with an empty ID list results in a BadRequest or 422 response.
